name: Grilled oysters
summary: Oysters grilled in the shell and served with sea urchin, roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion.
origin: Phu Quoc. The nature account is the one that names the oysters.
taste: Roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion, served with echinus. No other seasoning was printed.
howToEat: Eat them alongside grilled sea urchin, the way the island plates them.
seoDescription: Grilled oysters on Phu Quoc come with sea urchin, roasted shallots, peanuts, and green onion.
